snippet.title: Helix: Descent N Ascent - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Awaken in a gloomy, dark, and disembodied world. As you progress through your adventure, discover new abilities. Each one allows you to interact meaningfully with your surroundings and solve the many puzzles that await. Master the unique mix-and-match system that enables you to combine powers as you explore the barren lands of Helix.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736370/Helix_Descent_N_Ascent/

Get the soundtrack: https://jimguthrie.bandcamp.com/album/helix-descent-n-ascent-original-game-soundtrack

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/GNCgejvZ
